lines.en: I clamp onto a stone along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 吸盘嘴一张一合，挪半寸。
lines.en: My sucker mouth works and I shift an inch.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水慢，我顺着泥爬。
lines.en: The swamp water is slow; I crawl over mud.

lines.zh: 红树林的根缝里，我钻过去。
lines.en: I squeeze between mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 我拖着硬壳身体，走得很稳。
lines.en: I drag my armored body along steadily.

lines.zh: 河底的藻是我的，我慢慢啃。
lines.en: The bottom algae are mine; I graze slowly.
Suck, slide, and clamp again.
No rush; nothing hurries me on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我从这块石头爬到那块。
lines.en: I crawl from this stone to that one.

lines.zh: 泥里看不清，我靠嘴摸路。
lines.en: I cannot see in the mud; my mouth finds the way.
Weeds block me; I push through.

lines.zh: 我沿着倒木一路啃过去。
lines.en: I graze my way along a fallen log.

lines.zh: 丛林水浑，我照样贴着底。
lines.en: The jungle water is murky; I stay low.
I pause, then move half a foot.

lines.zh: 我吸住石面，慢慢往前挪
lines.en: I stick to the stone and inch forward.

lines.zh: 一片腐叶挡路，我从下面钻
lines.en: A rotten leaf blocks me; I slip under it.

lines.zh: 河底的沙太软，我吸不稳
lines.en: The river sand is too soft to hold my grip.

lines.zh: 我绕过一截沉木，继续啃藻
lines.en: I skirt a sunken log and keep grazing.

lines.zh: 我伏在石头上，一动不动。
lines.en: I lie flat on the stone without moving.
The bottom is still; only silt settles.

lines.zh: 我吸住玻璃一样的东西。
lines.en: I cling to something smooth as glass.
My armor is hard; it neither stings nor fears.
Algae sit by my mouth; I cannot be bothered.
The swamp water is tea-colored.
I hold tight; the current cannot take me.

lines.zh: 有东西从我背上爬过去。
lines.en: Something crawls over my back.
I open my mouth and silt billows away.
Mangrove roots sway in the water.

lines.zh: 我这一身壳，沉得像石头。
lines.en: This armor makes me heavy as stone.

lines.zh: 一动不动，别人就看不见我。
lines.en: If I do not move, I am not seen.
The bottom's chill presses my belly.
I wait for dark before climbing higher.
You are on the bank; I am on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在上面，能看见你。
lines.en: My eyes sit on top; I can see you.

lines.zh: 你踩的石头，是我吸着的。
lines.en: The stone you step on is the one I cling to.
Are you looking for a pleco?
I stay still, and you will not find me.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在泥上，很深。
lines.en: Your shadow falls deep on the silt.

lines.zh: 我吸住石头，你拽不动的。
lines.en: I am clamped to stone; you cannot pull me.
Crouch that long and your legs must numb.
Nobody in the swamp looks at me like this.
To catch me, take off your boots first.
My hard shell splits and the inside shows.
My sucker is knocked loose.
Only three hearts; stop hitting.
I lie in the silt, unable to right myself.

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了我的硬壳。
lines.en: That blow broke through my armor.
Water seeps into the wound, icy cold.
I can no longer hold onto the stone.
A corner of my fin is torn away.
It hurts, but I will not cry out.
I retreat into the roots until you leave.

lines.zh: 你放下的水草，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the waterweed you set down.

lines.zh: 藻的味儿，顺着水过来了。
lines.en: The smell of algae drifts over to me.
I creep toward it, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 那块石头上有藻，我看见了。
lines.en: That stone has algae; I see it.

lines.zh: 你把草压在石头上？正好。
lines.en: You pinned the weed on a stone? Perfect.
I open my mouth and scrape bite by bite.
I will not fight; you will not eat it anyway.

lines.zh: 这么厚的藻，够我啃很久。
lines.en: Algae this thick will last me ages.
I clamp beside the weed and grind slowly.
Once your hand lets go, I move in.
You kicked the stone I was on.
The bump slides me half a foot.

lines.zh: 我的吸盘松了，快贴回去。
lines.en: My sucker came loose; I must reattach.
Do not shove; this armor is heavy.
Silt billows everywhere; I cannot see.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩住我的尾巴了。
lines.en: Your foot is on my tail.
I am on the bottom; I should not be stepped on.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的壳倒是不疼。
lines.en: The bump does not hurt my shell.
The water churns; I cannot hold the stone.
I retreat into a gap between roots.
She clings to the stone beside mine.

lines.zh: 我们两张吸盘，贴得很近。
lines.en: Our two suckers hold very close.
I press my snout to her flank.
She moves an inch; I move an inch.
Bottom silt hides us both.
We graze the same patch of algae.

lines.zh: 她壳上的纹路比我的深。
lines.en: The ridges on her armor are deeper than mine.
I give her the better spot.

lines.zh: 有水流来，我们一起吸紧。
lines.en: A current comes; we both clamp tighter.
She leaves first; I follow slowly.
A clump of algae sinks; I take it.
I scrape it onto the stone with my mouth.
Whatever falls belongs to the bottom.
This rotting leaf still tastes of something.

lines.zh: 我用肚子压住这口吃的。
lines.en: I press the morsel flat under my belly.
Picking up scraps beats gnawing stone.
Bit by bit, I eat slowly.
Nobody contests this with me.
I clamp the food and grind it down.
Hidden away; I will eat tomorrow.
That patch of algae is thick; I head there.
I see a ring of green on the stone.

lines.zh: 有片叶子沉下来，我盯住。
lines.en: A leaf sinks; I fix on it.
That fallen log ahead is enough for me.
I pick the crevice to land in first.
A shadow in the depths; not a shark.

lines.zh: 这个位置有藻，我记住了。
lines.en: This spot has algae; I remember it.
I turn slowly toward that stem.
The target is close, among the roots.
I lock on, then creep over.

lines.zh: 我贴着底，一点一点靠近。
lines.en: I hug the bottom, closing in bit by bit.
The algae are ahead; I can smell them.
The current pushes it; I follow.
I am slow, but I will not lose it.
Sucker loose, sucker tight, I advance.
It is nearly at my mouth; I open up.

lines.zh: 我从石头缝里探出半个头。
lines.en: I poke half my head from the crevice.
Silt blocks me; I push it aside slowly.
Two more inches and I can reach.
It moves; I stop and wait.
I open my mouth and suck at its hide.
I ram it with my armor and it holds.
The suck fails; it slips away.
I clamp its fin and grind.
It shakes me, and I roll over.
My armor is hard; I take hits and stay.

lines.zh: 我撞它一下，就慢慢退回。
lines.en: I bump it once, then slowly withdraw.
My sucker leaves a round mark on it.
My strikes are slow but heavy.
After biting, I clamp back onto stone.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的浑水里出现。
lines.en: I appear in the murky swamp water.
I land beneath the mangrove roots.
The bottom silt stirs, and I wake.

lines.zh: 我和同伴占了两块石头。
lines.en: My companion and I take two stones.

lines.zh: 这水是茶色的，正好藏身。
lines.en: Tea-colored water; good cover.
First task: find a flat stone.
I clamp to the bottom to steady myself.

lines.zh: 丛林的水从上面流下来。
lines.en: Jungle water runs down from above.
This armor is newly grown.
I settle down and begin grazing.
The water is so hot my armor ticks.
I fall from a height onto stone.
Out of water, my sucker dries and cracks.

lines.zh: 炸声掀翻河底，我被埋了。
lines.en: The blast turns the bottom over; I am buried.

lines.zh: 一支尖物钉进我的壳缝。
lines.en: A sharp thing lodges in my armor's seam.
Cold force seeps under my armor.

lines.zh: 这块石头的藻早吃光了。
lines.en: This stone's algae ran out long ago.

lines.zh: 雷打进沼泽，我壳都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the swamp; my armor goes numb.
The riverbed splits and I fall through.
